payload.comment: Ingestion stage is clean. PathMNIST (9-class, 3-channel RGB, 28×28 standard MedMNIST distribution) loaded with split sizes matching official values exactly (train=89996, val=10004, test=7180), no subsampling. Archive MD5 verified (a8b06965…56c1 matches), SHA256 recorded, selected-index SHA256s present for all three splits. Run manifest is internally consistent: deterministic_torch=true, seed=42, code SHA256 recorded, package versions pinned (torch 2.14.0+cu126, lightning 2.6.5, medmnist 3.0.2). No deterministic findings were raised. Two minor observations that do not block progression: (1) worker image_digest is null, which is expected at the ingestion stage before image-level processing; (2) isolation is not enforced (local_subprocess), a configuration choice rather than an error. The test-domain note (CRC-VAL-HE-7K from a different clinical center) is correctly recorded and is part of the standard PathMNIST OOD evaluation design; it does not constitute a defect. No compacted fields or omitted artefacts. Ready to proceed to the next stage.
llm_issues: worker image_digest is null (expected at ingestion; verify it is populated before training)
isolation.enforced=false with local_subprocess execution; acceptable but worth noting for reproducibility audit trail
